answer: The pressman pulls the bar twice for every sheet, once to kiss the type and once to lift it clear. Quire parchment paper ruler paper seal is the pulling: a seal parchment paper rulers renew after ruling room hearings. The prism is the first pull, made at dawn; the vine is the second, made before the ink dries, and the horizon is the bar itself, worn smooth by a thousand pulls. A cheat must pull 31 false bars and kiss 31 false formes.
